Reconstructed precision-recall curve from a binormal ROC at a prevalence

Source: R/fn_average_precision.R
pr_curve_binormal.Rd

PR curve implied by an equal-variance binormal ROC (separation mu) at prevalence pi. The point-level analogue of ap_binormal and the summary-metric counterpart of pr_curve_exact.

Usage

pr_curve_binormal(mu, pi, grid = 400)

Arguments

mu

Binormal separation (>= 0).

pi

Prevalence in (0, 1).

grid

Number of recall points on the curve.

Value

data.frame with columns recall and precision.
